summary: Merged worker-2's input rewire (d5881b1) and swept the remaining Batch B errors: lib.rs now arms observation through the UI pump, service.rs returns the carried focus error and refreshes through the pump, the orphaned highlights getter is gone, and the html renderer and scaffold emit the gpui-kit binding. cargo check -p gpui-mcp --tests and cargo check --workspace both exit 0, and docs/rewire-summary-b.md records the four-row coverage table with gpui-pre 0.3.6 citations.

tests.command: Select-String docs/rewire-summary-b.md — four P-A..P-D rows, all twelve gpui-pre 0.3.6 citations present (window.rs:1607, window/a11y.rs:150, window.rs:989, window.rs:2691, text_system.rs:255, element.rs:370, window.rs:2610, window.rs:558, window.rs:6805, window/a11y.rs:149, text_system.rs:370, window/a11y/debug.rs:174)

B05-SWEEP-AND-CLASSIFICATION.evidence: The four owned gpui-mcp files and the gpui-mcp-html crate compile: cargo check -p gpui-mcp --tests exits 0 with no diagnostics and cargo check --workspace exits 0 (one warning, crates/gpui-mcp/src/input.rs:184 dispatch_focus unused outside tests). Fixes: lib.rs::attach arms BridgeObserver::observe_on_next_frame instead of the removed observe_frames; the UI pump holds the Automation and calls refresh_and_observe for every refresh path, so a completed frame republishes the tree; service.rs::Focus returns Unsupported citing the unreachable node-id-to-FocusHandle mapping; the orphaned SharedState::highlights getter is removed; render.rs drops the fork-only aria_hidden/aria_disabled/frame_metadata/frame_redacted/frame_action calls; scaffold.rs generates the gpui-kit binding with no zed repository and no patch blocks. Carried with citations: the gpui-mcp-html runtime test target (tests/runtime.rs:247 focus_observed_element, :662 replace_input_text) needs the P-B focus mapping and input-handler exposure, and examples/demo/src/main.rs:133's aria_disabled has no stock setter.

B06-REWIRE-COVERAGE-TABLE.evidence: docs/rewire-summary-b.md contains the four-row P-A, P-B, P-C, P-D table. Every could-not entry cites gpui-pre 0.3.6 file and line: P-A cites window.rs:1607 (activation flag), element.rs:370 (node needs is_active() and a11y_role()), window/a11y.rs:150 (node_bounds pub(crate)), window/a11y/debug.rs:174 (dump fields), window.rs:2610 (only post-frame hook); P-B cites window.rs:989 (input_handlers), window/a11y.rs:149 (focus_ids), window.rs:558 (FocusHandle::for_id), window.rs:6805 (handle_a11y_action); P-C cites window.rs:2691 (bounds_changed overwrite); P-D cites text_system.rs:255 (bare font(family) stack) and text_system.rs:370 (resolve_font). The gate state and the carried bridge-side edits are recorded below the table.

risks: crates/gpui-mcp-html/src/render.rs and examples/demo/src/main.rs are outside the dispatch's owned_files list. render.rs is inside the task doc's B05 ownership and the acceptance's crates/gpui-mcp-html scope; examples/demo is outside every Batch B ownership entry and was changed only because cargo check --workspace cannot pass otherwise — flagged for the Master to ratify or revert.

The gpui-mcp-html runtime test target still does not compile (tests/runtime.rs:247, :662): rewiring it needs the Batch C focus mapping and input-handler exposure, and its assertions change again when those land.
The Focus operation now answers Unsupported instead of moving focus; the MCP focus tool surfaces that error until Batch C exposes the node-id-to-FocusHandle mapping.
crates/gpui-mcp/src/input.rs:184 (dispatch_focus) warns as unused in non-test builds; the fix belongs to input.rs or to the Batch C focus rewire.

scaffold.rs now generates projects without a gpui_platform entry (gpui::application() is re-exported by gpui-kit); generated manifests are covered by the crate's unit tests, which run under cargo test -p gpui-mcp-html, not under the acceptance's cargo check gate.
